description.text: The tenth Sword & Shield set, released on 27 May 2022 with 189 cards plus secret rares and a 30-card Trainer Gallery. It goes back in time to the ancient Hisui region, with Origin Forme Dialga VSTAR and Origin Forme Palkia VSTAR and Hisuian Decidueye, Typhlosion and Samurott VSTAR, and it brought in Radiant Pokémon, a new kind of Shiny Pokémon card, with three of them.
